describe: TSMC monthly revenue as each press release stated it on its issue date, for the reports of September 2003 to October 2026 (278 releases, none missing in that span). Read from https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/<id> on 2026-11-22 through a page reader that returns quoted fragments, then parsed. Figures are in NT$ million; a release that stated billions to one or two decimals is exact only to that rounding.
not_covered: January 2002 to August 2003 were not read. No release states a time of day.
basis: From the April 2006 report to the December 2012 report a release gives an unconsolidated and a consolidated figure; from January 2013 consolidated only; before April 2006 the release names no basis. The consolidated year-on-year change is first stated in the April 2007 report.
checks: Every stated revenue figure and every stated year-on-year change was compared with tsmc_monthly_revenue_figures.json of this snapshot (the investor site's values on 2026-11-22). All agree within the rounding of the release, so no restatement of a monthly figure is visible in this span. One year-on-year change (November 2004, given only in a table) is left empty. Each issue date was compared with the EDGAR acceptance date in tsmc_monthly_revenue_events.json.
reader_caveat: The page reader paraphrased two year references (April 2013, April 2006 year-to-date); the figures in those rows agree with the check above. Wording was not otherwise verified against the pages.
observations_rule: observations holds the consolidated year-on-year change for the series tsmc:monthly_revenue:yoy_pct_as_released, one per release that states it, dated on the reported month's last day. A release states a date and no time, so each is available from noon UTC on the day after its issue date, with availability_basis assumed.
